lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in multiple parallel vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a semi-regular grid pattern along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity (light grey) intersecting with high-luminance circular spots, creating a lattice-like arrangement of nodes across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel horizontal features running along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity upper edges and low-intensity shadowed lower boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, high-luminance secondary subjects (commensal remoras) clustered around the pectoral fin and ventral region.
